preimport_reconciliation.matching: exact stable id, canonical legal name, BSE scrip code

method: Retained original annual-report PDFs were hash-checked, text-extracted with Poppler and visually reviewed on the cited physical pages. Listing approval is separate from the Prospectus-term review and from source collection.
boundaries: This review approves only actual 2023 equity listing dates and BSE scrip identities for the four issuers. Board mapping, NSE identity, ISIN and monetary minimum application amount remain null/unapproved. Prospectus conflicts, fixed-price semantics and provisional amounts are preserved unchanged.
